subject: Delay in procurement impacting close — MAP update requested
messages:
From: Tom Bennett <tbennett@acme-analytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Delay in procurement impacting close — need updated MAP

Grace,

Quick note from procurement here — they just confirmed a vendor review hold on the SOW (security clarification around KMS integration). The consequence is they won't be able to sign by the originally agreed close date (Jul 7).

Can you send an updated mutual action plan that reflects a realistic new close window? Procurement suggested a two-week push but asked if Redwood can confirm dedicated capacity and whether any technical gating can be parallelized to avoid further slippage. Also copied Sarah from the platform team who will coordinate the vendor evidence ask.

Attachments: procurement_hold_notice.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Bennett
Director of Platform Engineering
Acme Analytics
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Bennett <tbennett@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme-analytics.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Delay in procurement impacting close — need updated MAP

Tom — thanks for the heads up and for the details. I've drafted an updated MAP and a short risk log attached. High level: we can accommodate a two-week shift but will need to lock a small dedicated pool the week before the new cutover to guarantee capacity and the SLAs you expect. There are a few technical tasks we can parallelize to shorten the runway:

- Security evidence bundle: Laura will provide a redlined package for procurement (SOC 2 snippets + KMS integration checklist).
- Test harness staging: we can run the integration tests in parallel with procurement review if Acme gives token access to a staging VPC.
- Canary plan: we'll stage a single-shard canary on dedicated capacity the day before cutover to validate throughput.

Proposed new timeline (high-level):
- 2027-07-05: Redwood provides final evidence bundle and MAP v3
- 2027-07-12: Procurement review completes, signature window opens
- 2027-07-19: Target cutover (contingency to 2027-07-21 if procurement requires one more week)

Action items for Acme: confirm staging VPC token and procurement feedback by 2027-07-02.

I've attached: MAP-v3.xlsx (Mutual Action Plan v3) and MAP-v3-changelog.txt with what changed compared to v2. Please confirm and I'll move to DocuSign once we have procurement acknowledgement.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

Attachments: MAP-v3.xlsx (xlsx), MAP-v3-changelog.txt (txt)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Delay in procurement impacting close — need updated MAP

Forwarding Tom's note and the MAP draft. Quick ask: can we approve a one-week dedicated capacity reservation and a minor commercial concession if procurement confirms the two-week hold? Procurement specifically asked about capacity guarantees and a parallelization plan for evidence review.

Why escalate: this account is on an enterprise traction path, and if we don't lock capacity now they could be forced to switch deployment windows which increases churn risk.

Key questions for internal owners:
- Jonas: operational feasibility for locking one N+1 GPU node for the week of 2027-07-12 and a canary run on 2027-07-18.
- Laura: quick turnaround on the redlined evidence package and whether Legal is comfortable with a minor amendment to the SOW to add the one-week capacity hold clause.

I will stay on the thread with Tom/Sarah to keep procurement aligned.

Grace
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Delay in procurement impacting close — need updated MAP

Grace — we can do the small dedicated reservation for the week of 2027-07-12. Operational notes and mitigations below: 

- Capacity: reserve one N+1 node and an extra burst slot; will mark capacity reserved under ACME-PRIO. We'll need confirmation by 2027-07-02 to avoid reallocation.
- Cost/credits: recommend offering a one-time credit equal to one week of baseline token spend as a gesture — simple approval from Sales Ops required. That should satisfy procurement without materially impacting ARR.
- Technical gating: we can start the canary deployment as soon as we have tokenized staging access; the integration tests that depend on KMS can run against a stubbed KMS instance for initial validation. Final KMS testing must be done in their staging VPC.

I'll update our internal risk log:
- Risk: procurement hold delays signature beyond window -> Impact: +/- 2 weeks
- Mitigation: capacity reservation + credit + parallelized evidence delivery
- Owner: jonas.weber@redwood.com

Set me up with dates and I'll file the reservation.

Jonas
Head of Production Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com, Tom Bennett <tbennett@acme-analytics.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Delay in procurement impacting close — need updated MAP

Tom/ Sarah/Team — Laura here from Legal. I reviewed the MAP-v3 and the proposed minor SOW amendment for the capacity hold. Legal is comfortable with a one-week hold clause and the phrasing in the change log; we recommend adding a short acceptance window (7 days) for the amendment once procurement confirms to keep momentum.

I've added a couple of tiny redlines in the evidence bundle (SOC 2 excerpt + KMS checklist) and attached the marked document to the DocuSign envelope. Grace — I'm good for immediate send to DocuSign after Acme confirms the staging token and procurement acceptance of the one-week hold.

Next steps:
- Acme to confirm procurement acceptance and staging token by 2027-07-02
- Grace will send DocuSign link with MAP-v3 and SOW amendment (7-day acceptance window)
- Jonas to file capacity reservation under ACME-PRIO on confirmation

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abcdef123456
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/123456789/detail

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

--
